{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check the rows with NaN revenue to see if they are test orders
# Look at the 'converted' column — if it's 0, it might be a test order
# Also check 'status' and 'channel'
df[df['revenue'].isna()][['order_id', 'channel', 'status', 'converted']].head(10)"}
